question: Who won a gold medal for India in the javelin throw event at Tokyo Olympics 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Neeraj Chopra

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra is originally from Khandala village in Panipat, Haryana. 
 
• He was born on 24 December 1997. His father Satish Kumar is a farmer.
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian Track and field athlete and a Junior Commissioned Officer in Indian Army.
 
• The distance reached by the javelin in the gold medal-winning throw by Neeraj Chopra at the Olympic games held in Tokyo in 2021 lay between 87.5 m and 88.0 m.
 
• Tokyo Olympics: India's Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in the men's javelin throw event with a throw of 87.58m in his second attempt.
 
• Neeraj is the first Indian in over 120 years, and the first athlete from independent India, to win an Olympic medal in a track-and-field discipline.
 
• Chopra also became the sixth Indian athlete to win an individual medal at Tokyo 2020 joining weightlifter Mirabai Chanu, shuttler PV Sindhu, boxer Lovlina Borgohain, and wrestlers Ravi Kumar Dahiya and Bajrang Punia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• At the Gold Coast Commonwealth Games, Neeraj threw an 86.47-meter spear and won the gold medal.
 
• India's star javelin throwing athlete Neeraj Chopra threw the javelin 88.07 meters away in the fifth attempt.
 
• It Breached the national record of 88.06 meters to win the gold medal in the 2018 Asian Games.
 
• Parsa Singh of India won the silver medal in the first Asian Games (1951) played in Delhi.
 
• After this, in the 1982 Asian Games (Delhi), India's Gurtej Singh won the bronze medal.
 
• So far no athlete had achieved a gold medal in the javelin throw, but Neeraj Chopra made the best-ever performance for India in the javelin throw.
